note: #651 §7.3. Fourteen synthetic (evidence, card) pairs, two per perturbation class. Every card is well-formed Chinese copy that passes the deterministic lint, so the only thing separating a supported pair from an unsupported one is the claim itself. `faithful_paraphrase` and `supported_strong_conclusion` must pass: a judge that catches every perturbation by rejecting everything is useless in the opposite direction, and these are the only cases that see it.

cases.note: The filing is Circle's; the card credits Visa.

evidence.title: Circle files to offer 2.4 million additional Class A shares
evidence.content: Circle Internet Group said in an S-1 amendment that it will offer 2.4 million additional Class A shares. Visa is named only as an existing commercial partner.

card.why_zh: 增发扩大流通盘，短期对Visa股价形成稀释压力。

cases.note: The exchange listed the token; the card says the issuer listed itself.

evidence.title: Binance to list SEI perpetual futures on 12 September
evidence.content: Binance announced it will open SEIUSDT perpetual futures on 12 September at 08:00 UTC with up to 25x leverage. Sei Foundation made no announcement.

card.headline_zh: Sei基金会9月12日上线SEI永续合约
card.why_zh: 项目方自行开合约意味着流动性由其自控，风险敞口集中在发行方。

key_facts: 币安将于9月12日上线SEIUSDT永续合约

cases.note: An annual rate presented as a daily one.

evidence.title: Protocol reports 18% annualized staking yield
evidence.content: The protocol's dashboard reports an 18% annualized staking yield on locked deposits, unchanged from last month.

card.headline_zh: 该协议质押日收益率达18%
card.why_zh: 日化18%的回报远高于同类协议，会迅速吸引套利资金流入。

cases.note: USD restated as CNY at the same magnitude.

evidence.title: Company announces $250 million buyback
evidence.content: The board authorized a share repurchase programme of up to 250 million US dollars, to run through the end of the fiscal year.

card.headline_zh: 公司宣布2.5亿元人民币回购计划
card.why_zh: 回购规模约占流通市值的一小部分，对每股收益的提振有限。

cases.note: Conditional regulatory approval stated as settled.

evidence.title: Merger cleared subject to divestment of the payments unit
evidence.content: The competition authority said the merger may proceed only if the acquirer divests its payments unit within nine months. No divestment has been agreed.

card.why_zh: 审批落地移除了交易的最后一道障碍，合并进度不再受阻。

key_facts: 批准以九个月内剥离支付业务为条件
forbidden_claims: 该并购已获无条件批准

cases.note: A listing conditional on a review presented as a supply guarantee.

evidence.title: Exchange admits token to conditional listing review
evidence.content: The exchange said the token has entered a conditional listing review and that admission depends on the outcome of that review.

card.headline_zh: 该代币确认上线交易所
card.why_zh: 上线带来新增买盘，二级市场深度将立即改善。

key_facts: 该代币仅进入有条件上市审核

cases.note: An authorized programme reported as completed purchases.

evidence.title: Treasury authorizes purchase of up to 5,000 BTC
evidence.content: The company's board authorized the purchase of up to 5,000 BTC over the next twelve months. No purchases have been made to date.

card.headline_zh: 该公司已买入5000枚比特币
card.why_zh: 实际买入使流通供给减少，对现货价格构成直接支撑。

key_facts: 董事会授权未来十二个月内最多买入5000枚比特币

cases.note: A signed letter of intent reported as a closed deal.

evidence.title: Parties sign non-binding letter of intent
evidence.content: The two companies signed a non-binding letter of intent to explore a joint venture. No definitive agreement has been signed and no consideration has been paid.

card.headline_zh: 双方完成合资公司交割
card.why_zh: 交割完成后收入将并表，本年度业绩指引存在上修空间。

key_facts: 双方仅签署无约束力意向书

cases.note: The card invents a macro cause the evidence never names.

evidence.title: Token falls 12% over six hours
evidence.content: The token fell 12% over six hours on rising spot volume. The report names no cause.

card.why_zh: 美联储推迟降息触发风险资产集体回撤，该代币因此承压。

forbidden_claims: 下跌由美联储推迟降息引起

cases.note: A wallet balance turned into a buyback mechanism.

evidence.title: Foundation wallet balance rises to 40 million tokens
evidence.content: An on-chain address labelled as the foundation treasury now holds 40 million tokens, up from 25 million. The source of the inflow is not identified.

card.headline_zh: 基金会钱包余额升至4000万枚代币
card.why_zh: 基金会在二级市场回购推高余额，流通量因此收缩。

key_facts: 基金会地址持仓从2500万枚升至4000万枚
forbidden_claims: 余额上升源于二级市场回购

cases.note: Same facts, different wording. Must pass.

evidence.title: Exchange raises maintenance margin on SOL perpetuals to 6%
evidence.content: The exchange raised the maintenance margin requirement on SOL perpetual futures from 4% to 6%, effective immediately.

card.headline_zh: 交易所将SOL永续维持保证金上调至6%
card.why_zh: 维持保证金从4%升至6%后，同等仓位需要更多占用资金，高杠杆多头的清算线被抬高。

cases.note: Rounded but equivalent number, and an attribution the evidence carries. Must pass.

evidence.title: Issuer confirms quarterly revenue of $1.203 billion
evidence.content: The issuer confirmed quarterly revenue of 1.203 billion US dollars in its own filing, above the 1.15 billion consensus.

card.headline_zh: 发行方确认季度营收约12亿美元
card.why_zh: 公司自行披露的12.03亿美元高于11.5亿美元的市场一致预期，收入端超预期。

key_facts: 高于11.5亿美元的一致预期

cases.note: A direct, unavoidable inference from the stated numbers. Must pass.

evidence.title: Protocol pauses withdrawals after 92% of the pool is drained
evidence.content: The protocol paused all withdrawals after 92% of the liquidity pool was drained in a single transaction. Remaining depositors cannot exit.

card.headline_zh: 协议在流动性池被抽空92%后暂停提现
card.why_zh: 池子只剩8%而提现已暂停，仍在池内的存款人短期内无法退出，损失已经锁定。

cases.note: A limit of the evidence stated as such, which is a valid explanation. Must pass.

evidence.title: Regulator opens formal proceedings against the exchange
evidence.content: The regulator opened formal proceedings against the exchange over unregistered securities offerings. No penalty has been set and the exchange continues to operate.

card.headline_zh: 监管机构对该交易所启动正式程序
card.why_zh: 正式程序意味着调查进入可处罚阶段，但处罚金额尚未确定，交易所目前仍在正常运营。

key_facts: 监管机构就未注册证券发行启动正式程序
